verdict.rationale: Tavily is a web search API, so finding pages similar to a given URL is a fair question for it. The evidence shows search, extract, crawl, map and research endpoints, but no similar-pages or find-similar capability. Crawl and Map only traverse or map pages within the site at a base URL, which is a different capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can find pages similar to a URL I already have
